name: TWEAK
author: thazm
description: Go under the cube portal between the spikes and saw at 5.8%. Navigate through the gameplay as the wave while avoiding all portals except for the reverse gravity portal which you need. At 17%, fall above the level after passing the yellow orb and saw. Stay above the gameplay until 77% where you need to be very close to the ceiling to avoid a wall of invisible saws and then you can hold until the end.
